audit_answers.5_worker_count_mismatch_reason: Before V2 there was no canonical worker registry. Each subsystem (recruitment, sandbox, OpenClaw, model lanes, coding department, agent slots, onboarding queue, etc.) kept its own slate of workers. The dashboard read a few of these (notably workers.json + recruitment), while the Kernel read others (mostly its symbolic graph). The two counts diverged because no module deduplicated across the source registries, and several modules reported different totals depending on which subset they queried. V2 consolidates every source under qsb_canonical_workers.json and publishes one reconciliation count.
